nom: Jack Black Pure Clean Daily Facial Cleanser

segments.oily: Several reviewers with oily skin (including oily forehead or oily T-zone) report the cleanser removes excess oil without over-drying, and one who alternates it with a bar soap for oily skin finds both effective.
segments.dry: Reviewers describing dry or flaky skin, and one in a dry mountain climate, report the cleanser cleans without leaving skin dry or tight, though one reviewer with essential-oil sensitivity found it caused flaking when used twice daily.
segments.combination: One reviewer with oily/dry combination skin and large pores describes it as a daily staple that cleans without excessive drying.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers who call their skin sensitive are split: some report it calmed redness and irritation and caused no eye or skin sting, while others report breakouts, burning, or eye stinging on sensitive skin.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her mid-fifties and one man of advanced age report continued satisfaction and occasional but infrequent pimples, describing it as a reliable long-term cleanser.

concerns.aging: A reviewer in her mid-fifties reports only infrequent occasional pimples and no other aging-related complaint; no reviewer reports anti-aging effects specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers who mention dryness report the cleanser does not leave skin feeling dry or tight even with twice-daily use; one dissenting reviewer with dry, flaky skin found it caused flaking when used more than once a day.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sensitive, redness-prone skin reports the cleanser reduced redness and irritation over time, and another with gym-related T-zone redness reports noticeably less redness after regular use; one reviewer reports the opposite, with the product leaving her face looking and feeling sunburned.
concerns.barrier: A reviewer with sensitive skin and a compromised, easily-irritated barrier reports this cleanser worked when other long-used cleansers had stopped agreeing with her skin; a couple of other reviewers report burning or a reaction suggesting barrier irritation.
concerns.spots: A parent reports a teenage son's acne cleared substantially over weeks of twice-daily use paired with a matching moisturizer, avoiding prescription medication; against this, two reviewers report new pimples or breakouts appearing after starting the product.
concerns.blemishes: Several reviewers report fewer or no new blemishes with regular use, including one who still gets an occasional pimple at 55 but far less often since switching; two reviewers explicitly report breakouts after use.
concerns.oiliness: Multiple reviewers with oily skin report it removes oil and shine effectively while leaving skin feeling clean, not stripped; no reviewer reports it failing to control oil.

aspects.libelle: Pump dispenses too much or is stiff
A little product goes a long way
Burning or stinging sensation on face or eyes
Contains essential oils causing flaking with frequent use
Good value for longevity of the bottle

extraits.texte: Product basically burned my face. Used as directed, don't have particularly sensitive skin. Felt and looked like a sunburn. Great reviews and at the price point I assumed a good purchase. Perhaps works for others but a waste of money for me.
It made me break out and didn't even leave my face feeling clean :(

extraits.titre: Love this but hate the pump!
extraits.texte: I'm a woman with incredibly dry and flaky skin. I've tried many different face washes but in desperation I tried this after my husband bought it for himself. Now I won't use anything else! I love that it doesn't smell "manly" either. The pump is terrible though, it's really hard to push down and when it does it pushes out a FULL pump, forcing us to use way more face wash than we want and wasting it.

extraits.titre: A Must Have For Sensitive Skin
extraits.texte: In the last few years, my face has become increasingly sensitive, becoming more red and irritated. Cleansers that I have used for years had suddenly stopped working on my face. I had tried different products, from other brands like to no avail, so I decided to give this wash a try, since it already had a mild toner in it. I have been a long time fan of Jack Black products already, and we sell it where I worked, so I gave it a try and fell in love. It cleans well, reduces redness, and does not dry my skin well. I follow it with the Double Duty face moisturizer. My only issue is that it does not seem to penetrate my beard as much as I'd like, so I'll be giving the beard wash a try soon, but otherwise, it's a nose perfect product.

I should have written this review a long time ago, but here it is. My son was struggling with acne that covered most of his face. We went to see a dermatologist, and of course, they recommended and put him on a certain medication that starts with the letter A( that the filter will not allow me to type in this review. ) After 2 months of seeing what that medication was doing to my son (please research warnings/side effects before putting your child on this) I stopped the medication and searched for a new skin care line to try. I purchased this cleanser and the face moisturizer to go with it. I made sure my son used both products morning and night every single day. Literally, within a couple weeks, his skin was clearing up beautifully. After a month of use, he had a completely clear, beautiful complexion. He received complements regularly on how great his skin looked. It's been 2 years since I purchased our first Jack Black facial products and to this day, my son's skin is flawless. My husband and other son also use JB products. In my opinion, Jack black products are very cost effective, considering how long they last and how well they work. I'm not saying it works for everyone, just saying that if you are at the point of considering Acc-----, give this a try first!

I have been using this face cleanser for about 8 months and have noticed that I have less redness. I am prone to redness in the T area of the face due to excessive sweating at the gym. I use this morning and night and works great. A little goes a long way, so I use it sparingly.

I've been using this for over a year now. It's my go to daily cleanser. Cleans well without excessive drying. I have oily/dry sensitive skin with large pores. I've tried many other popular brands. Face Buff and Daily Cleanser are my Jack Black Staples.
